step1_analysis.description: A static voltage divider using diode-connected NMOS and PMOS transistors to generate a stable reference voltage (likely VDD/2) for sense amplifiers or bitline precharge in a cache memory. It includes a dummy/capacitor NMOS (XMN2) for node stabilization.

paper_reference.title: A 0.8-V 128-kb Four-Way Set-Associative Two-Level CMOS Cache Memory Using Two-Stage Wordline/Bitline-Oriented Tag-Compare (WLOTC/BLOTC) Scheme

V_ref.description: DC output reference voltage at node N0

sky130_expected.calculation: Equating pull-up and pull-down currents: 1850u*(1.38-V_N0)^2 = 2700u*(V_N0-0.42)^2 -> V_N0 ≈ 0.85V
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with VDD. For VDD=1.8V, it acts as a near VDD/2 divider.
Depends heavily on the W/L ratios and Vth. Expected to be around 1mW for SKY130 at 1.8V.

R_out_dB.description: Small-signal output impedance in dB ohms

sky130_expected.calculation: Total gm = sum(gm_n) + sum(gm_p) ≈ 4.28 mS. R_out = 1/gm ≈ 233 ohms. In dB: 20*log10(233) ≈ 47.3 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the transconductance of the diode-connected devices.

Line_Regulation.description: Sensitivity of output voltage to supply voltage variations (dV_ref/dVDD)

sky130_expected.reasoning: As a resistive divider, the output tracks the supply voltage with a factor of roughly 0.45.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC reference voltage, power consumption, output impedance, and line regulation of the bias generator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VDD/2 Voltage Reference Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmn0=5u L_xmn0=0.5u
.param W_xmp0=5u L_xmp0=0.5u
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u
.param W_xmn2=5u L_xmn2=0.5u
.param W_xmn3=5u L_xmn3=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_load N0 0 DC 0 AC 1

XMN1 N0 N0 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMN0 N0 N0 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn0} w={W_xmn0}
XMP0 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp0} w={W_xmp0}
XMP1 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}
XMN2 N0 VDD N0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn2} w={W_xmn2}
XMN3 VDD VDD N0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn3} w={W_xmn3}

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let v_ref = v(N0)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print v_ref power

* 2. AC Analysis for Output Impedance
ac dec 10 1 1G
let z_out_db = vdb(N0)
meas ac r_out_db find z_out_db at=1k

* 3. DC Sweep for Line Regulation
dc VVDD 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_ref_18 find v(N0) at=1.8
meas dc v_ref_17 find v(N0) at=1.7
let line_reg = (v_ref_18 - v_ref_17) / 0.1
print line_reg

quit
.endc
.end
